title: NASA announcement of Planet X / Planet 10

tellings.quote: announcement by NASA and I do believe this was a real announcement where they did announce this planet and they called it Planet n or Planet 10

plain: NASA once announced a new planet in the outer solar system, calling it "Planet n or Planet 10", according to Matt LaCroix, a guest who adds, "I do believe this was a real announcement." He places it in the 1990s and raises it with Michels in an episode about something he believes happened around 12,000 BC, where an unseen large body out past the known planets would matter to that story.
